Task 4821

Team directory

Adds an optional "Team directory" module so workspaces can list members with photos, roles and short bios on their public site.

Behaviour

  • Model: first name is required. Last name and image are optional. Each workspace's extra fields (role, bio, links…) come from its directory.model config through SampleKit data_fields, so adding a field needs no migration.
  • Config: a directory block in defaultv1/v2/v3 with enabled, noun, sortable, hide_image, hide_hidden_field and after_commit_callbacks.
  • Admin: list, new, edit, delete and drag-to-reorder at /admin/directory, modelled on Documents and App Blocks. The image and hidden inputs follow hide_image and hide_hidden_field. The pages return a 404 when the module is off.
  • API v1: /api/v1/directory (index and show). It needs both api_v1.enabled and directory.enabled. demo-site doesn't have API v1 turned on, so it gets a 404 there.
  • App feed: a directory key in FeedJob, only for workspaces with the module on. The image is left out when hide_image is set.
  • Fix: Web::V1::BaseController raised NoMethodError for v1/v2 workspaces, because their configs have no api_v1 block. They now get a 404.

Test plan

  1. Enable directory.enabled on demo-site, add three members and reorder them.
  2. Confirm /admin/directory 404s with the module off.
  3. Hit /api/v1/directory with and without api_v1.enabled.
  4. Check the demo-site app feed: directory should list the visible members in order.
